## Settled formalization decisions

1. ℝ^d is `EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)` with `volume`; cubes are half-open axis-parallel cubes.
2. Scalars: an arbitrary `RCLike 𝕜`; B₁, B₂ Banach spaces over 𝕜; B₂* = `StrongDual 𝕜 B₂`.
3. 𝒮_B = Borel simple functions with compact support (`SimpleFunc` + `HasCompactSupport`);
   operators are 𝕜-linear maps 𝒮_{B₁} → (ℝ^d → B₂) with a.e.-strongly-measurable values.
4. Λ*_γ is the supremum over γ-sparse families in **all** Lerner–Nazarov dyadic lattices
   (see ErrorReport E1).
5. The adjoint hypothesis (p-q-rescaled-reg-b) is stated in dual (pairing) form (ErrorReport E3).
6. Lorentz quasinorms: ‖f‖_{p,∞} = sup_t t·|{|f|>t}|^{1/p}, ‖f‖_{q,1} = q∫₀^∞|{|f|>t}|^{1/q}dt
   (Grafakos, Classical Fourier Analysis, 1.4.1/1.4.9); equivalent to the paper's norms up to
   constants depending on p, q only (ErrorReport E2).
7. Corollary 3.4 is proved by a direct Haar/martingale-difference argument instead of Lemma 3.2
   (ErrorReport E4).
8. Infinite Whitney families are handled by finite truncation with a vanishing remainder, so all
   operator inputs remain simple functions (ErrorReport E5).
